scenes.headline: How a robot searches before it moves
scenes.sub: A vision-language model writes trajectories; a simulator tests every rewrite.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Idli! Today: how a language model drives a robot arm by testing many trajectories in simulation first.

scenes.text: Treat a whole robot trajectory as one node in a search tree, and let a simulator test every rewrite before the real arm moves.
scenes.mark: a whole robot trajectory as one node
scenes.say: A whole trajectory is one node in a search tree. Each edge is a rewrite. A simulator tests every node.

steps.say: Fetch the past success that looks most like this scene, as an example.
The model writes a full trajectory: positions, rotations and gripper commands.
A simulator runs and films it; the same model grades the video.
That score is the node's value. Scores pinned to each step go back for the next rewrite.

scenes.title: Turning a video into a number
scenes.say: The task is split into ordered subtasks.

parts.note: share of the current subtask done
parts.say: add how much of the current one is done,
divide by the number of subtasks, and average over fifty frames.

steps.say: In the paper's figure, each frame is graded against its subtask: reach, grasp, pull.
The feedback tags every old step with its score, so the model sees where progress stopped.

scenes.title: Same budget, two ways to spend it

left.title: Sample independently
left.say: Fifteen independent proposals find a pass for about half the seeds.

right.title: Search with scored rewrites
right.say: The same fifteen, spent on scored rewrites in a tree: sixty-five percent.

scenes.title: Seeds where a passing trajectory was found
scenes.note: Six simulated tasks, 20 seeds each; success is the simulator's check
scenes.say: One proposal finds a pass for a quarter of the seeds. Forty-five nodes, nearly three quarters, and flattening.

scenes.title: From simulator to real arm
scenes.say: On a real arm, the loop runs in a copy of the table.

items.say: A depth camera finds the block and bowl; the simulator places them.
Search there, and stop at the first pass.
Only that one goes to the arm. Five of six trials worked.

scenes.text: The search is only as good as its checker: here, a simulator that says pass or fail.
scenes.mark: only as good as its checker
scenes.say: Remember: the search is only as good as its checker, and here the checker is a simulator.

recap: A whole trajectory is one node
Scores pinned to steps guide rewrites
Only the simulator's winner reaches the arm
scenes.say: Whole trajectories as nodes, scores on steps, and only the winner moves the arm.
